gaps.sentence: Don't ___ up all the milk — we need some for breakfast.
gaps.explanation: use up = finish the whole supply of something.

gaps.sentence: This job calls ___ someone with patience.
gaps.explanation: call for = require, demand (circumstances call for action).

gaps.sentence: The hotel was full, so we couldn't check ___.
gaps.explanation: check in = register; check out = leave and pay.

gaps.sentence: Don't worry — he always turns ___ late.
gaps.explanation: turn up = arrive, often unexpectedly or late.

gaps.sentence: He loves showing ___ his new car to the neighbours.
gaps.explanation: show off = try to impress people with your abilities/possessions.

gaps.sentence: It took all morning to sort ___ the garage.
gaps.explanation: sort out = organize/put in order, or solve (a problem).

gaps.sentence: The scientists carried ___ a series of experiments.
gaps.explanation: carry out = perform, conduct (research, a plan, an order).

gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.
